note: A slow orb of lightning that keeps striking the area around it (modelled as a zone that pulses for two seconds).

def.name: Drifting Storm
def.description: Looses a slow orb that strikes the ground around it with lightning.

note: A short preparation, then five projectiles loosed one after another, a little off line; because they come in sequence, every one of them can hit the same enemy.

def.name: Quiver Rush
def.description: Looses five arrows one after another; all of them can strike the same enemy.

note: A channelled flurry: the character keeps striking, each strike building a stage worth 20% more damage (six at most); when it lets go it makes one more strike for each stage built, each at the full bonus.

def.name: Flurry of Edges
def.description: A flurry of strikes in a wide arc; each builds a stage, and letting go adds a strike for every stage built.

note: Each cast adds a blade that circles the character for five seconds (up to ten); the blades hit everything around together, the rounds coming 35% sooner, the damage 35% greater and the critical chance 10% better for each blade.

def.name: Orbiting Blades
def.description: Each cast sets a blade circling you; the more blades, the harder and faster they cut.

note: Volleys of blades rain on an area (modelled as a zone that pulses five times).

def.name: Rain of Steel
def.description: Steel rains down on the area in volleys.

note: A spinning attack around the character that leaves a storm of blades for three seconds, half as hard as the spin, in the stance the character is in: a still one that makes you attack faster while you stand in it, or a drifting one that makes you move faster. Three storms at most.

def.name: Whirlwind Cleave
def.description: A spinning attack that hits everything around you and leaves a storm of blades.

note: Arrows rain on an area as fire (all physical converted to fire, with fire penetration).

def.name: Ember Downpour
def.description: Looses arrows that fall as fire on an area.

note: A channelled breath of chaos in front of the character that adds a layer of damage over time to every enemy in the area with each breath: a layer lasts two and a half seconds and there can be twenty; an enemy not already withered is slowed for a moment. It does not hit.

def.name: Withering Breath
def.description: A withering breath that lays layer upon layer of rot on everything in front of you while you hold it.

note: A fire arrow that ignites harder than most; an ignite it causes also leaves a burning debuff worth a third of its damage, for four seconds, up to five at once.

def.name: Torch Arrow
def.description: Looses a burning arrow that ignites its target and leaves it burning.

note: A chaos arrow that bursts where it lands and leaves caustic ground for two seconds: the enemies standing in it take chaos damage over time, which does not stack between patches. The ground comes even if the arrow misses.

def.name: Acid Arrow
def.description: Looses an arrow that bursts and leaves poisonous ground.

note: A poisonous projectile that chains between enemies, from a dagger or a claw.

def.name: Viper Lash
def.description: A poisonous lash that leaps from enemy to enemy.

note: A burst of cold at the target that leaves chilled ground for five seconds, growing to twice its size, that hurts with cold; a kill on it has a 25% chance to give a Fervour charge. It waits three seconds, unless a Fervour charge is spent.

def.name: Sudden Frost
def.description: A sudden burst of frost at a target place.

note: A debuff of chaos damage over time on every enemy in the area, for five seconds; it does not hit. When an enemy that carries it dies, it passes on to those near it with the time it had left.

def.name: Creeping Plague
def.description: A spreading plague that gnaws at every enemy in an area, and passes on when they die.

note: Needs a corpse near the target: it bursts for a share (4%) of the life it had as fire, and becomes a geyser for eight seconds that sends projectiles down about it, one after another, each bursting. Three geysers at most.

def.name: Pyre Burst
def.description: Burn a corpse into a geyser that sends fire down about it.

note: A channelled storm: each use builds a stage and zaps the enemies nearby for half damage (a crowd builds stages faster); letting go fires a beam in front of the character that hits harder for every stage built.

def.name: Judgement Tempest
def.description: Gathers a storm around you that zaps the enemies nearby; letting go sends a beam, stronger for every stage built.

note: Two fast strikes with a melee weapon, with a chance to bleed.

def.name: Twin Cut
def.description: Two fast strikes in the time of one.

note: Strikes with both weapons at once, with more critical chance; against enemies on full life it crits twice as often and deals 30% more damage. Dual wielding only.

def.name: Twin Blades
def.description: Strikes with both weapons at once. Needs two weapons.
